candidatesAccepted.title: Chic-Chocs hut-to-hut route with a navigation-first kit list
candidatesAccepted.summary: A hut-to-hut route in the Chic-Chocs suits your demanding effort and rustic-night limits, and your earlier fair-weather trip gives you a base. Your stated limit is cloud navigation, which these ridges can bring on quickly, so the kit is the point: topographic map, compass, a GPS unit with offline maps, and layers for wind and wet. I could not account for your access needs, which were not answered, so please raise them with the park before you commit. Trail and hut status, and whether the route is open, must come from Sépaq, which runs the park's reservations, and from the Parc national de la Gaspésie office. This is an option to research, not clearance to go.
